scripts.build: mkdir -p .vercel/output/functions/api.func && bun build src/index.ts --outfile .vercel/output/functions/api.func/index.mjs --target node && node scripts/post-build.cjs && cp $(node -e "console.log(require.resolve('pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.mjs'))") .vercel/output/functions/api.func/pdf.worker.mjs && cp -r $(node -e "const p=require.resolve('pdfkit/js/pdfkit.js');console.log(require('path').join(require('path').dirname(p),'data'))") .vercel/output/functions/api.func/data && printf '{"runtime":"nodejs20.x","handler":"index.mjs","launcherType":"Nodejs","maxDuration":300}' > .vercel/output/functions/api.func/.vc-config.json && printf '{"version":3,"routes":[{"src":"/(.*)","dest":"/api"}]}' > .vercel/output/config.json
